sources.quote: 10.6mm의 두께와 236g의 무게는 ‘갤럭시 Z 폴드6’와 비교했을 때 1.5mm 얇고 3g이 가벼다.
커버 스크린의 경우 21:9의 비율의 164.8mm(6.5형) 디스플레이가 적용돼
‘갤럭시 Z 폴드 스페셜 에디션(Galaxy Z Fold Special Edition)’을 25일 국내 출시한다.

notes: Korea/China-only model; samsung.com DOES list it (Korean product page https://www.samsung.com/sec/smartphones/galaxy-z-fold6-se-f958/SM-F958NZKAKOO/ ) but that page's spec table is rendered client-side and returned no spec text to curl, so the values here come from the Samsung Newsroom Korea launch press release, which is primary but gives only THICKNESS and WEIGHT -- no folded/unfolded height or width, no unfolded thickness, no resolutions, no panel type, no refresh rate. Those are all null rather than borrowed from the Z Fold6. Translations: '10.6mm의 두께와 236g의 무게' = 'a thickness of 10.6mm and a weight of 236g'; '메인 스크린은 20:18 비율의 203.1mm(8.0형)' = 'the main screen is a 20:18 ratio 203.1mm (8.0-inch) display'; '커버 스크린 ... 21:9의 비율의 164.8mm(6.5형)' = 'the cover screen is a 21:9 ratio 164.8mm (6.5-inch) display'; '25일 국내 출시한다' = 'launches domestically on the 25th' (of October 2024). The 10.6mm is stated as 'the thickness' with no hinge/sagging pair -> depth_at_hinge null. Widely reported full dimensions (e.g. 142.6 x 157.9 x 5.6 mm) appear only on GSMArena-class sites and are NOT recorded here. || EVIDENCE SWEEP 2026-09-13: these values were present in the research pass but carried NO sources[] entry covering their field, so they were set to null per the registry rule (a value without a citation is an assertion, not evidence). Preserved verbatim here so a human can re-source rather than re-research: displays[0].aspect = '21:9'; displays[1].aspect = '20:18'; hinge.type = 'book'; hinge.axis = 'long'.
